title: Sleeps 45 | 4 Homes | Rooftops • Hot Tub • Karaoke
description:
★ Katie Hill Collection by AvantStay ★

• 4 homes just north of downtown Nashville
• 16 bedrooms, sleeps 45 guests
• 4 private rooftops with skyline views
• 4 private hot tubs
• Karaoke lounge + multiple game and entertainment spaces
• Fire pits, Smart TVs, and 4 fully equipped kitchens
• About 10 minutes to Broadway
• Near Nissan Stadium, Germantown, East Nashville, Topgolf, and Pontoon Saloon

The space
Welcome to The Lodge, That ’70s Show, The Great Gatsby, & Girls Night Out by AvantStay! Together, these four homes offer a combined total of 16 bedrooms and space for up to 45 guests—an ideal setup for large group trips, celebrations, reunions, or event weekends in Nashville, with plenty of room to spread out while still staying close.

Set just north of downtown along the Cumberland River, this collection gives your group the best of both worlds: quick access to Nashville’s biggest attractions and stylish private spaces to come home to. Broadway’s iconic honky-tonks, rooftop bars, and live music venues are about a 10-minute ride away, while Nissan Stadium, Germantown, East Nashville, Topgolf, and nearby Pontoon Saloon river cruises are all within easy reach. Across the four homes, your group will enjoy an incredible mix of standout amenities, including multiple private rooftop lounges with skyline views, four hot tubs, game and entertainment spaces, fire pit hangouts, fully equipped kitchens, smart TVs, and thoughtful layouts designed for groups traveling together.

The Lodge brings a cozy, cabin-inspired atmosphere to the heart of the city. A dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace anchors the open-concept living space, where natural textures and warm tones create a comfortable setting for gathering after a day in Nashville. The fully equipped kitchen with stainless-steel appliances makes group meals easy, while four ensuite bedrooms themed after iconic National Parks provide privacy and comfort for up to 12 guests. The real showstopper is the fully enclosed private rooftop, where your group can soak in the hot tub, dine, play games, and relax with skyline views and a large TV. With smart TVs throughout, in-unit laundry, and dedicated parking, The Lodge blends the feel of a mountain retreat with the energy of Music City.

That ’70s Show delivers a playful retro experience packed with personality. Bold colors, vintage-inspired design, and music-forward details make this home feel lively from the moment you arrive. Inside, the bright open-concept living area flows into a dining space and fully equipped kitchen, while standout features like custom guitar speakers, an Edith Bunker piano, a cards table, bumper pool, and a game console create endless opportunities for fun. The home sleeps up to 9 guests across four bedrooms, including three king rooms and a flexible lofted sleeping space. Upstairs, the rooftop lounge offers another unforgettable gathering spot, complete with a private hot tub, comfortable seating, string lights, and sweeping Nashville skyline views.

The Great Gatsby brings dramatic Art Deco flair and speakeasy-style energy to the group experience. Rich textures, bold design, and lounge-worthy spaces make this home feel elevated, cinematic, and celebration-ready. The main floor is open and inviting, with plush seating, a Smart TV, and a fully equipped kitchen that makes hosting feel effortless. Downstairs, a private lounge with velvet seating, games, a player piano, and a curated bar area sets the stage for unforgettable nights in. This home sleeps up to 12 guests across four well-appointed bedrooms with a mix of king beds, queen beds, and flexible loft-style sleeping arrangements. Outside, guests can gather on the private back deck around the fire pit or head up to the fully private rooftop, where skyline views, lounge seating, and a hot tub create a secluded and stylish place to unwind.

Girls Night Out is built for unforgettable celebration weekends, with glam design and entertainment spaces that make the stay feel like the event itself. The open-concept main level is bright, stylish, and made for connection, with a fully equipped kitchen, dining space, and playful design touches throughout. Downstairs, the home’s private karaoke lounge steals the show, featuring a high-end karaoke setup, dedicated stage, full sound system, large TV, and plush seating for the ultimate at-home concert experience. The home sleeps up to 12 guests across four bedrooms, including three ensuite bedrooms and a flexible loft-style room for additional guests. Outside, the private deck with a fire pit offers a cozy place to gather, while the rooftop takes things to the next level with a private hot tub, pink lounge seating, bar stools, and sweeping downtown views. Dedicated makeup mirrors and getting-ready stations add an extra layer of convenience for groups heading out on the town.

Together, these four homes create a one-of-a-kind Nashville buyout experience—equal parts stylish, playful, and group-friendly. Whether your crew is planning rooftop happy hours, karaoke nights, game tournaments, late-night hot tub hangs, or mornings recovering over coffee before the next adventure, this collection gives you the space, privacy, and personality to make the most of every moment in Music City.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. 

There's a reason Nashville, TN has become one of the country's most loved southern cities. With its vibrant nightlife, country music scene, and incredible food, "Nashvegas" is a top destination for people simply looking to have a good time- which means lots of drinking and eating. Visitors flock to Broadway, a street lined with multi-level bars playing live music and serving BBQ. You might get stuck in traffic behind party bikes called Pedal Taverns, but you're more likely to cheer them on than get road rage because having fun is part of the culture in Nashville.

Experience Nashville, AvantStay style!

Other things to note
Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee on each property; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay’s approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.

Parking Details:
- Guests may park in two spaces directly in front of the unit and one garage space. A limited number of overflow parking spaces are also available on site.

[DISCLAIMERS]
  - No smoking in or outside of this home. Subject to a $500 fine.
  - Occupancy and noise limits are strongly enforced. Subject to fines that can reach up to $10,000 per violation.
  - IDs and security deposits when applicable will be requested after booking
  - We have the right to report and prosecute all Credit Card Fraud

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
